dedupe_keys.name: translink trips by public transport in the netherlands 2019 to 2024

description: This dataset holds Translink's estimates of the number of journeys and related statistics for public transport in the Netherlands from 2019 to 2024, derived from smart-card check-ins and check-outs. Translink supplied the data to Erasmus MC on behalf of the R2M2P2 consortium, and the record was published on DataverseNL in 2026. Coverage is national public transport in the Netherlands over a period that includes the COVID-19 pandemic. Access: the metadata are open under CC BY-NC 4.0, but the data are only available after signing a Data Transfer Agreement, and sharing them outside the consortium needs case-by-case consent from the public transport operators; commercial use is restricted. Caveats: statistics that could relate to fewer than 50 people were censored before delivery, and the exact spatial and temporal resolution is not described in the metadata read. It supports public transport demand analysis, disruption and pandemic impact studies and calibration of network flow models, and complements the Mobility Database catalogued here.
